questions.question_text: What document must you present if a police officer requests it after an incident?
options: A copy of your car purchase receipt
questions.explanation: Drivers are legally required to produce their driving licence if requested by a police officer.

questions.question_text: If a police officer asks to see your documents after a road incident, which document are you legally required to produce?
questions.explanation: You are legally required to show your driving licence, insurance certificate, and MOT certificate if requested by a police officer following an incident.

questions.question_text: Which of these documents must you produce if a police officer asks to see them?
options: Your MOT certificate, insurance, and driving licence
Your passport and vehicle purchase receipt
A copy of your car manual
questions.explanation: Drivers are legally required to produce these documents upon request by the authorities.

questions.question_text: When are you required to show your insurance certificate to a police officer?
options: Only if you have been involved in an accident
Only if you are driving a commercial vehicle
If they ask to see it at any time while driving
Only if your car is over 3 years old
questions.explanation: You must be able to produce your driving documents if requested by a police officer.

questions.question_text: Which documents must you be prepared to provide if asked by a police officer?
options: Driving licence, insurance, and MOT certificate
questions.explanation: Police officers are legally allowed to request proof of your identity, vehicle insurance, and that your vehicle is roadworthy.

questions.question_text: At what point are you legally required to present your insurance certificate to a police officer?
options: Only if you have been involved in an accident
Only if you are stopped for speeding
questions.explanation: You must produce valid insurance documentation if a police officer asks to see it while on duty.
